About Me

I am an Accounting Honours student at Universiti Sains Malaysia with an interest in auditing, business, and technology. I enjoy understanding how financial information supports decisions and exploring practical ways to apply what I learn. Through academic projects and student activities, I continue to develop my analytical thinking, communication, and teamwork skills.

Beyond my studies, I have been involved in student leadership, event coordination, and activities that connect students with the accounting profession. These experiences have taught me to take responsibility, work with different people, and stay organised. I am also interested in data analytics and digital innovation, particularly how tools such as Excel and Power BI can make information clearer and more useful.
